source.title: ShadowBench: Toward Reliable Automatic Evaluation of Semantic Alignment in Autoformalization
source.note: Per-difficulty and per-area pass rates (%) on ShadowBench-178. Compile is the standalone Lean compile rate. SA-PASS(Soft) is the average fraction of forward and backward checkers that pass (compile-gated). SA-PASS requires all forward and backward checkers to pass. Category breakdown generated by scripts/build_leaderboard_category_results.py (see leaderboard_categories/README.md).
